svg.title: thinC Architecture (as of Part 92)
svg.desc: thinC hardware/workload orchestration platform architecture: REST-only client surfaces (thincctl CLI, web dashboard, the PID1-spawned physical console) talking to the thincd daemon, which is the sole process with direct access to the container runtime library and every host/network/DNS/PKI/LDAP/NTP/package/exec primitive (API-First Mandate, ADR-0005). Below the daemon: the container runtime it drives -- namespaces/cgroups, OverlayFS, the custom rtnetlink data plane -- plus a consolidated log store with optional syslog forwarding, LDAP-backed Unix/SSH account sync, and the A/B boot / on-disk layout thincd manages as host PID 1.
svg.text: Hardware & workload orchestration platform — client-daemon, REST-first, hand-rolled from source (docs/mission/MISSION.md) — as of Part 92
CLIENT SURFACES — pure REST clients, zero direct runtime access (ADR-0005)
left resource tree, bottom log panel
scp's new OS/package images onto the box
out-of-band — no registry, no remote fetch
thincd — THE ONLY PROCESS WITH RUNTIME/NETWORK/DNS/PKI/LDAP/PKG ACCESS
thincd — single-threaded, non-blocking epoll reactor (ADR-0007, ADR-0009)
hand-rolled HTTP/1.1 + JSON, no external libraries, dynamically linked against system glibc, TCC-compiled
Container Runtime Library (include/container.h) — linked directly into thincd only
CONTAINERS — each its own namespaces + cgroup, driven by thincd, never by CLI/web directly
exists as a REST endpoint FIRST.
HOST OS — thincd itself as real PID 1, no initramfs (Phase 11)
Read-only squashfs A/B root, systemd-boot's native boot counting (ADR-0014)
One boots, one is the write target for
the NEXT update — never touched live
net.conf — static IP applied at boot
falls back to tmpfs if absent
own QEMU test target and the
Reflects Phase 39: interactive container console over a hand-rolled WebSocket (ADR-0043); PID1-spawned physical console (ADR-0034).
Root+intermediate PKI CA tier and site-scoped DNS/PKI naming (ADR-0046/0047, ADR-0049-0053); stateless host-side per-container stats (ADR-0054).
Phase 40: container file-read endpoint (ADR-0055); hostbuild artifacts (ADR-0056); self-hosted rebuild + REST-driven ISO assembly (ADR-0057, ADR-0064).
Bare-metal readiness: cpu.max/cpuset, kernel modules (ADR-0060/61); ext4+btrfs disk quotas (ADR-0062/103/104); kernel routing + route CRUD (ADR-0066/67); ISO self-build (ADR-0063/64).
DNS/pkg reliability fixes; image versioning — pinned/rolling, per-version immutable rootfs (ADR-0107/108); per-container disk selection (ADR-0102); opt-in output capture (ADR-0112).
LDAP: glauth registration, user/group CRUD, automatic SSH + service-account provisioning (ADR-0109, ADR-0111); NTP host clock sync + container time sources (ADR-0110).
pkg/ redesign (five parts): configurable recipe repo + sync, build-artifact cache, declarative image recipes, rolling images/containers with restart jitter (ADR-0120-125).
Logging/web-UI epic (six parts): transparent container log capture, optional syslog forwarding, merged log panel, host stats + process list pages (ADR-0126-132).
Source of truth for what shipped: docs/roadmap/ROADMAP.md — for why: docs/adr/. Update this diagram whenever a change alters a box or arrow shown here (CLAUDE.md).
